questions.name: In a line of people, Rohit is ranked 12th from the top, and Ankit is ranked 20th from the bottom. If there are 30 people in the line, how many people are between Rohit and Ankit?
questions.nameText:
In
 a line of people, Rohit is ranked 12th from the top, and Ankit is
 ranked 20th from the bottom. If there are 30 people in the line,
 how many people are between Rohit and Ankit?

options.name: 5
7
0
9

questions.solution:
Rohit position from bottom = (30-12)+1 = 19

Ankit position from bottom = 20

Number of people between Rohit and Ankit = 0

questions.name: Arjun is older than Sumit but younger than Rahul. Vikas is younger than Rahul but older than Arjun. Ramesh is the oldest among them. Who is the third oldest?
questions.nameText:
Arjun
 is older than Sumit but younger than Rahul. Vikas is younger than
 Rahul but older than Arjun. Ramesh is the oldest among them. Who
 is the third oldest?

options.name: Sumit
Arjun
Rahul
Vikas

questions.solution:
From the given conditions:

Arjun > Sumit, but Arjun < Rahul.

→ Rahul > Arjun > Sumit.

Vikas is younger than Rahul but older than Arjun.

→ Rahul > Vikas > Arjun > Sumit.

Ramesh is the oldest.

Final order: Ramesh > Rahul > Vikas > Arjun > Sumit.

The third oldest is Vikas.

questions.name: Six people—P, Q, R, S, T, and U—are standing in a line from left to right. P is taller than S but shorter than Q. R is taller than Q but shorter than U. T is the tallest. Who is the fourth tallest?
questions.nameText:
Six
 people—P, Q, R, S, T, and U—are standing in a line
 from left to right. P is taller than S but shorter than Q. R is
 taller than Q but shorter than U. T is the tallest. Who is the
 fourth tallest?

options.name: P
Q
R
S

questions.solution:
From the given conditions:

P > S, but P < Q → Q > P > S.

R > Q, but R < U → U > R > Q.

T is the tallest.

Final order: T > U > R > Q > P > S.

The fourth tallest person is Q.

questions.name: Shreya is taller than Meena but shorter than Ritu. Kajal is shorter than Ritu but taller than Meena. Payal is the shortest among all. Who is the third tallest?
questions.nameText:
Shreya
 is taller than Meena but shorter than Ritu. Kajal is shorter than
 Ritu but taller than Meena. Payal is the shortest among all. Who
 is the third tallest?

options.name: Shreya
Ritu
Meena
Kajal

questions.solution:
From the given conditions:

Shreya > Meena but Shreya < Ritu.

→ Ritu > Shreya > Meena.

Kajal is shorter than Ritu but taller than Meena.

→ Ritu > Kajal > Meena.

Payal is the shortest.

Arranging all: Ritu > Shreya > Kajal > Meena > Payal.

The third tallest person is Kajal.

questions.name: In a row of students, Raj is 15th from the left end and 12th from the right end. How many students are there in the row?
questions.nameText:
In
 a row of students, Raj is 15th from the left end and 12th from the
 right end. How many students are there in the row?

options.name: 26
28
25
30

questions.solution: Total students in the row = (Position from Left) + (Position from Right) – 1 = 15 + 12 - 1 = 26

questions.name: In a row of 45 students, Aditi is ranked 18th from the left. Priya is 24th from the right. If there are 5 students between Aditi and Priya, how many students are there in the row?
questions.nameText:
In
 a row of 45 students, Aditi is ranked 18th from the left. Priya is
 24th from the right. If there are 5 students between Aditi and
 Priya, how many students are there in the row?

options.name: 45
47
50
53

questions.solution:
Total students in the row = (Aditi’s rank from the left) + (Priya’s rank from the right) + (Students between them)

= 18 + 24 + 5

= 47

questions.name: Rahul is heavier than Suresh but lighter than Mohan. Kunal is lighter than Rahul but heavier than Suresh. Deepak is heavier than all except Mohan. Who is the second lightest?
questions.nameText:
Rahul
 is heavier than Suresh but lighter than Mohan. Kunal is lighter
 than Rahul but heavier than Suresh. Deepak is heavier than all
 except Mohan. Who is the second lightest?

options.name: Rahul
Kunal
Suresh
Mohan

questions.solution:
Rahul is heavier than Suresh but lighter than Mohan. → Mohan > Rahul > Suresh

Kunal is lighter than Rahul but heavier than Suresh. → Mohan > Rahul > Kunal > Suresh

Deepak is heavier than all except Mohan. → Mohan > Deepak > Rahul > Kunal > Suresh

Solution:

The second lightest is Kunal.

questions.name: In a north-facing row of 45 students, Neha is 13th from the left, and Priya is 15th from the right. There are 4 students between Priya and Rani, who is equidistant to Neha. What is Rani’s position from the right?
questions.nameText:
In
 a north-facing row of 45 students, Neha is 13th from the left, and
 Priya is 15th from the right. There are 4 students between Priya
 and Rani, who is equidistant to Neha. What is Rani’s
 position from the right?

options.name: 25
20
30
32

questions.solution:
Priya’s position from the left = 45−15+1=31.

Rani’s position from the left (5 places ahead of Priya) = 31−5=26.

Check equidistance: ∣26−13∣=13 (same as Neha's position). 

Rani’s position from the right = 45−26+1=20.

questions.name: Five students—Amit, Bhavesh, Chetan, Dinesh, and Esha—took an exam. Amit scored higher than Chetan but lower than Bhavesh. Dinesh scored more than Amit but less than Esha. Esha scored the highest. Who got the second highest marks?
questions.nameText:
Five
 students—Amit, Bhavesh, Chetan, Dinesh, and Esha—took
 an exam. Amit scored higher than Chetan but lower than Bhavesh.
 Dinesh scored more than Amit but less than Esha. Esha scored the
 highest. Who got the second highest marks?

options.name: Dinesh
Chetan
Amit
Esha

questions.solution:
From the given conditions:

Amit > Chetan, but Amit < Bhavesh.

→ Bhavesh > Amit > Chetan.

Dinesh > Amit but Dinesh < Esha.

→ Esha > Dinesh > Amit.

Esha scored the highest.

Final order: Esha > Dinesh > Bhavesh > Amit > Chetan.

The second highest scorer is Dinesh.

questions.name: In a class of 50 students, Priya ranks 14th from the top. What is her rank from the bottom?
questions.nameText:
In
 a class of 50 students, Priya ranks 14th from the top. What is her
 rank from the bottom?

options.name: 35
37
40
45

questions.solution:
Rank from the bottom = Total students - Rank from the top + 1

= 50 - 14 + 1

= 37

questions.name: If the rank of Rohan is 7th from the top in a group of 50 candidates and 2 new candidates are added just before and after him, what will be his new rank from bottom?
questions.nameText:
If
 the rank of Rohan is 7th from the top in a group of 50 candidates
 and 2 new candidates are added just before and after him, what
 will be his new rank from bottom?

options.name: 44
45
46
48

questions.solution:
Adding of candidates just before Rohan will not change his rank from bottom. Before addition, the rank of Rohan from bottom is = (50 - 7) + 1 = 44

Now adding 2 candidates just after Rohan will increase his rank by 2 positions. Hence; the new rank of Rohan from bottom will be = 44 + 2 = 46

questions.name: Neha is heavier than Rina but lighter than Simran. Aisha is lighter than Neha but heavier than Rina. Jaya is heavier than all except Simran. Who is the third heaviest?
questions.nameText:
Neha
 is heavier than Rina but lighter than Simran. Aisha is lighter
 than Neha but heavier than Rina. Jaya is heavier than all except
 Simran. Who is the third heaviest?

options.name: Rina
Simran
Neha
Jaya

questions.solution:
From the given conditions:

Neha > Rina, but Neha < Simran → Simran > Neha > Rina.

Aisha is lighter than Neha but heavier than Rina → Simran > Neha > Aisha > Rina.

Jaya is heavier than all except Simran → Simran > Jaya > Neha > Aisha > Rina.

The third heaviest person is Neha.

questions.name: In a line of 60 people, Sam is ranked 21st from the top. How many people are ahead of him and how many are behind him?
questions.nameText:
In
 a line of 60 people, Sam is ranked 21st from the top. How many
 people are ahead of him and how many are behind him?

options.name: 20, 39
20,40
22,39
22,40

questions.solution:
People ahead of Sam = Sam’s rank - 1 = 21 - 1 = 20

People behind Sam = Total - Sam’s rank = 60 - 21 = 39

questions.name: In a nursery, I saw a group of small rose trees arranged in a row. However, one rose tree caught my attention very much. I started counting its rank from the left hand side and found out to be 12. When I started counting from right hand side, it was again 12!! What is the total number of rose trees that were arranged in that row?
questions.nameText:
In
 a nursery, I saw a group of small rose trees arranged in a row.
 However, one rose tree caught my attention very much. I started
 counting its rank from the left hand side and found out to be 12.
 When I started counting from right hand side, it was again 12!!
 What is the total number of rose trees that were arranged in that
 row?

options.name: 21
25
32
23

questions.solution:
As the rank of the tree is same from either side, the total number of trees will be

12 + 12 – 1 = 23

questions.name: In a north facing row of NCC Cadets, Trisha is 9th from the left end and Tina is 12th from the right end. There are 5 cadets between Trisha and Tanya who is equidstant to Tina. Find how many cadets are there in the row?
questions.nameText:
In
 a north facing row of NCC Cadets, Trisha is 9th from the left end
 and Tina is 12th from the right end. There are 5 cadets between
 Trisha and Tanya who is equidstant to Tina. Find how many cadets
 are there in the row?

options.name: 34
31
32
33

questions.solution:
Adding all the persons in the above image, we get:

8 + 1(Trisha) + 5 + 1(Tanya) + 5 + 1(Tina) + 11 = 32

Thus there are 32 cadets in the row.

questions.name: Aman is standing in a queue at the 10th position from the front. If he is 15th from the back, how many people are in the queue?
questions.nameText:
Aman
 is standing in a queue at the 10th position from the front. If he
 is 15th from the back, how many people are in the queue?

options.name: 30
75
50
24

questions.solution:
Total people in the queue = (Position from Front) + (Position from Back) - 1

= 10 + 15 - 1

= 24

questions.name: In a class of 35 students, Ziya is placed 7th from the bottom where as Sofia is placed 9th from the top. Shahruk is placed in between the two. What is Ziya's position from Shahruk?
questions.nameText:
In
 a class of 35 students, Ziya is placed 7th from the bottom where
 as Sofia is placed 9th from the top. Shahruk is placed in between
 the two. What is Ziya's position from Shahruk?

options.name: 10
15
19
21

questions.solution:
As seen in the figure, Shahruk is between Sofia and Ziya. It's given that Ziya is 7th from the bottom and Sofia is 9th from the top.

Therefore, number of persons between Sofia and Ziya = 35-(9+7) = 19

Sharuk's position between Sofia and Ziya = 19-1/2 = 10.

Hence, Shahruk is at the middle ie. at 10th position from both. Ziya, therefore, is at the 10th position from Shahruk
